# Camp Resource: Sunset Sarsaparilla Vending Machine

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 8, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9b6f6944d7e8400985d624595e4ff69e~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Sunset Sarsaparilla Vending Machine__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_90740250e6ef4bedaa74c0e10ba93642~mv2.jpg)

**Image Credit:** SugarBombs.RADS

*Satisfy your thirst with a Sunset Sarsaparilla! If you're lucky, you might get a rare Star Size Sunset Sarsaparilla – a super-sized edition released in limited quantities to select Canadian and U.S. test markets!*

__Overview__

The Sunset Sarsaparilla Machine dispenses nostalgic beverages from the West, including the elusive Star Size variant.

__Function__

| **Item Dispensed** | **Drop Rate** | 
| Star Size Sunset Sarsaparilla | 15% | 
| Sunset Sarsaparilla | 85% | 
| Irradiated Sunset Sarsaparilla | 85% | 

- Dispense Rate: 1 drink per use, with a 5-minute cooldown (300 seconds)
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: N/A – 15 caps per use

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: 
 - Nuka-Cola Mystery Machine
 - Classic Nuka-Cola Mystery Machine
 - Americana Nuka-Cola Mystery Machine
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No (assumed)
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 1

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Glass
- 1x Gears
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: N/A – operates on a cooldown system

__How to Unlock__

Season Reward: Season 22 – X – Page X – X Tickets

Tradeable: No

Giftable: No

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
